_comment: PAIP2020 demo slides. Derived assets (web-display Deep Zoom, Whole Tumor Area GT, nucleus overlays) are hosted in Jae-Hoon-Jeong/projectpage_essets projects/sena_nbe/v2/paip/ (PROVENANCE.md there). Overlay and GT coordinates are native level-0 pixels (native_size); the viewer scales them to the displayed DZI.

slides.title: PAIP2020 training_data_44
slides.attribution: PAIP2020 training_data_44, provided by Seoul National University Hospital (CC BY-NC 4.0); web-display Deep Zoom (0.50 µm/px) derived from the original slide.
slides.note: Whole Tumor Area = pathologist annotation from PAIP2020. Nucleus layers and predicted tumor area = model predictions (frozen release v1.0.1; tumor area: Neoplastic core plus Connective/Dead-supported tissue within 100 µm, holes filled).
